Define the normalised omitted overlap on the Gram supports by
\[
 C_w=(P_w^+)^{1/2}R_w(Q_w^+)^{1/2},\qquad s_j=\sigma_j(C_w),\qquad
 \ell_D=\frac12\sum_j\log(1-s_j^2).
\]
The superscript \(+\) denotes the Moore--Penrose inverse, followed by its positive square root; dependent bundle columns are allowed. For all supported singular values \(s_j<1\), the prescribed positive-addition model obeys
\[
 \ell_D\le f(D)\le0,\qquad f(S)+\ell_D\le f(K)\le\min\{0,f(S)\}.
\]
The omitted-cycle lower limit is approached as both positive spring coefficients grow without bound on their supports. A shared supported direction with \(s_j=1\) gives no finite uniform lower bound; finite known positive strengths still give a finite exact correction. Empty bundles give zero cycle.
